summary: Benchmark script under scripts/ that builds a ~40MB db and times db.all() and a search, to show where JSONStorage read time goes.
narrative: The owner suspected JSONStorage re-parses the whole file on every query and asked for numbers. So far memory holds one observation: table reads go through _read_table, which calls storage.read on each access. That is consistent with their hunch. No benchmark script, timings or PR are recorded yet, so the work is still at the exploring stage.
